title: The Import window: wireframes
intro: How the Import window looks and works, from what's merged on main and what the design and the tracker plan for 1.0.
reading: Boxes are regions, numbers point to the notes under each wireframe, and counts are made up. Every region says where it stands:

planned.meaning: In the tracker for 1.0; its engine may exist without its panel.

flow.title: Insert a card
flow.text: The window opens on it, its photos browsed from their embedded previews before anything is copied.

flow.title: Cull before copying
flow.text: Choose, rate and flag with the library's keys; photos already in the library are left out and counted.

flow.title: Say where they go
flow.text: A destination, folder and name templates with a live example, and a backup that's a real copy.

flow.title: Import and eject
flow.text: One journaled copy off the main thread; each card says when it's safe to erase.

principles.title: Nothing waits on the card
principles.text: Previews come from the files' embedded JPEGs, newest first, so culling starts before copying does.

principles.title: One journal
principles.text: A forced quit resumes the import where it stopped; nothing is half copied.

principles.title: The same keys as the library
principles.text: Ratings, flags and labels work in the window as they do in the grid.

screens.name: The window
screens.summary: One window of three columns, as the import begins.

regions.label: Photos
regions.note: 892 to import · the 312 already imported are left out

notes.title: Sources
notes.text: Cards as they're inserted and any folder added, each with its count; photos already imported are counted apart.

notes.title: The photos
notes.text: Newest first from their embedded previews, chosen, rated and flagged with the library's keys before copying.

notes.title: Where they go
notes.text: Destination, folder and name templates with a live example from the first chosen photo, a backup and raw only.

notes.title: Metadata presets
notes.text: A preset's ticked fields applied at the destination; a disabled place in the window today.

tables.title: Keys
rows: Rate and flag the chosen photos before copying
Choose every photo of the source
Eject the card once it's safe

screens.name: Eject
screens.summary: The sheet that says when a card can be erased, after the copy and its backup are checked.

regions.label: Progress
regions.text: Copying 412 of 892, then checking each against the card

notes.title: Progress
notes.text: The copy and then the check, each with its count, so the window can be left while it runs.

notes.title: Safe to erase
notes.text: Offered only once the copy and the backup match the card; whether erasing is on by default is yours to say.

questions.title: Is erasing the card on by default?
questions.now: Nothing is erased today. The sheet offers Eject and erase once every photo is copied and checked.
options: Off: erasing is ticked each time
On, once the backup matches too
Remember the last choice for each camera
questions.lean: Off: a card erased by habit is the one mistake the window can't undo.

questions.title: Does the window open when a card is inserted?
questions.now: It does, with a setting to turn it off.
options: Show a notification first, opening the window from it
questions.lean: Open it: a card goes in to be imported, and the setting is one click away.
questions.answer: Open it, as now; the setting stays in Preferences.
